nonblocking_findings: PDF images 257–262 show printed pages 255–260 under the running header חזרת התפלה. The page numbers run in order and alternate correctly between left and right pages.

Printed p.255: there is a slightly larger gap above the final row, 'יְיָ צְבָאוֹת יָגֵן עֲלֵיהֶם / The Lord of Hosts will protect them', than between the rows above it. This is cosmetic only and nothing is clipped or misaligned.
Printed p.255: the 'בשבת. / On the Sabbath.' heading is set apart from the Shofar verses above it by a divider rule. It reads clearly as a new section.

Speaker labels (קהל, חזן) are printed in bold on the Hebrew side only. The English rows have no matching label. This is the same on every page in the range, so it looks like a deliberate stylesheet choice.

Every note marker (↗) appears on both the Hebrew and the English side of the same row. Hebrew and English pairs: p.255 אָנוּסָה/I hasten; p.256 שְׂעִירוֹת/hands; p.257 וְנִלְוָה/in captivity; p.258 סֶלָה/Truly and כַּכָּתוּב/As it is written; p.259 רֶגֶשׁ/There will be; p.260 בִּנְעִימוֹת/voice. The note text is not on these pages, which is expected.

Printed p.258 ends on the introduction 'כַּכָּתוּב עַל יַד נְבִיאֶךָ / As it is written through Thy prophet:' and its verse (Isaiah 27:13) opens p.259. The page break falls cleanly between rows and no row is split.

Printed p.260 ends partway through Psalm 150 (verse 5), with blank space below. The text presumably continues on the next page, which other reviewers have. The closing pages, the priestly-blessing introduction and the missing-source label are not in this range, so they were not checked here.
verdict: Approved for PDF images 257–262 (printed pp. 255–260). Nothing is clipped or overlapping. The Hebrew, including vowel points, and the English are fully readable. Every stanza and verse row is paired and aligned top to bottom, Hebrew lines wrap cleanly, and every note marker appears on both sides. Speaker labels and section headings are placed consistently. The only findings are a minor spacing difference on p.255 and points that match the stated stylesheet choices.
